Arcadian Morning Report: All the latest news and happenings in arcadia! Get the scoop before anyone else!

Entertainment Channels

Please Be Happy: The most popular elation show in arcadia, now in its sensational seventh season!

Don't Look at the Moon!: Do those of us born in arcadia truly understand the Phantasmoon? Popular tragedy star Seafeld Kid brings you a series of sorrowful, eerie, yet heartwarming tales.

Cosmic Showdown Spectacular: The masters are among the common folk, so let's uncover the daily lives of these low-key card sharks!

Daybreak Squadron: Planarcadia's hottest special effect, airing every Sunday at 8 PM!

Magical Girls of Many Faces: Save the world? Nah, our goal is to purify everyone's souls! The year's best feel-good animation, don't miss it every Friday at 9 PM!

How to Safely Place a Cucumber Behind a Lightpaw: The longest and most entertaining safety education documentary in history. Season 43 is now streaming!
